# derivation evidence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:derivationEvidence`](gmeow-derivationEvidence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationEvidence>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The usage attestations, sources, or other evidence supporting a derivation claim. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a derivation may be supported by multiple evidence nodes, and evidence assessments vary by standpoint.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

Use [`gmeow:derivationEvidence`](gmeow-derivationEvidence.md) from [`gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on an [`EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) to attach the usage attestations, sources, or other evidence that support the derivation claim.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating the evidence as proof of correctness (it supports, not settles, the claim) and avoid forcing a single evidence node — derivations may rest on several, so keep it non-functional.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:derivationEvidence`](gmeow-derivationEvidence.md) at [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) nodes, sources, or other [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) evidence; carry the confidence the evidence warrants on the observation spine.
